Subject: Project Update: Revised Delivery Date of 14 April

I'm writing to update you on the timeline for your project. During integration testing, we identified that the third-party certification required for one of the core components is taking longer to complete than the vendor originally estimated, which has pushed our schedule back by two weeks.

Our team has been working closely with the vendor to move the certification along as quickly as possible, and all other elements of the project remain on track and unaffected by this delay. Based on the current certification timeline, we now expect to deliver the completed project on 14 April, and we will let you know immediately if anything changes.

Does 14 April still work well with your own plans on your end, or is there a specific date after that we should be aware of? We appreciate your patience and are happy to jump on a call this week if you would like to discuss the details further.
